author: ojiudezue
title: First OC live run (Sonnet, L03) failed: picked the decoy root cause and cited facts it never read; prompts AND pack will be tuned on dev cases only
summary: Harness worked (12% tool errors, all guards held). Agent saw radars go quiet and concluded 'correct vacancy, she left' instead of 'phone held the room, a BLE hop emptied it, BLE cannot re-create'. Judge flagged invented ZK/LD2410 and adjacency claims. Cost $1.62. Also: macOS `security -w` prompt truncates at 128 chars; HA tokens need -w "$(pbpaste)".
why: Operator asked why not tune prompts: agreed. The plan only forbids tuning on held-out cases; the 526-char system prompt is under-optimised. Dev loop now edits both pack (occupancy composition rules) and prompt (every claim from a tool result, read the code path before concluding), each with a general rationale in PACK_CHANGELOG.
implications: Held-out cases stay the control; no tuning after freeze. L02/L08 evidence expires 11-06.
revisit_trigger: If dev-round gains come only from case-specific wording, the freeze result is invalid.
